candidates.statement: Gateway checkout POSTs return 502 because the downstream order service returns 500 on POST /v1/orders; traces and logs show the gateway's client call to order failing with 500, propagating as 502 to /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side root cause (db, payment, inventory) not observed; only gateway-side evidence available.

report.explanation: Gateway telemetry consistently shows 502 on /v1/checkout caused by 500 responses from the order service on POST /v1/orders. The proximate fault is the order service's 500; the gateway merely propagates it. Order-side evidence is absent, so the deeper cause is unconfirmed.
missing_evidence: Order service traces/logs for POST /v1/orders to identify the internal 500 cause
Order service metrics for dependency operations (payment, inventory, postgresql) outcomes
